fields.caption: Silent Sentinel Under the Aurora
fields.alt: A dark silhouette of a mountain peak set against a starry sky with vivid green auroras dancing in the background.
fields.story: A majestic mountain stands silhouetted against a vibrant display of the Northern Lights, casting an ethereal glow over the night sky. The scene is serene and otherworldly, capturing the raw beauty of nature's celestial spectacle.
